verdict.headline: NOT YET - no statistically clear edge; the fix behaves like an ordinary price level so far.
details: At the fix level price bounced 36% of the time (360 touches) vs 41% at placebo levels (-4 pts, p=0.112).
Magnet beta: fix 0.002 (t=0.16) vs placebo 0.0046 (t=0.46). Negative = price pulled back toward the level.
